messages:
Elaine (AM): Quick sync - large enterprise wants a 4-week pilot for a chat embed. Peak traffic target: ~4k RPS spikes during business hours, expected steady state after ramp 500-1k RPS. Need capacity sketch, ballpark commit pricing, and security questionnaire responses. Who can pair on presales?
Sam (SRE): I can help. Do we know average request/response token counts and whether streaming is required? Also which regions?
Elaine (AM): They provided token profile: ~60 tokens in prompt, ~160 tokens out. No streaming for pilot. Multi-region read (US/EU) but pilot likely US primary. Pilot start in 2 weeks, smoke week -> spike week -> steady.
Raj (SalesEng): Quick tokens calc: 4000 RPS * 220 tokens = 880k tokens/sec peak (~52.8M tokens/min).
Maria (Infra): Model/quantization assumptions matter a lot. Using a conservative production throughput estimate of 220k tokens/sec per GPU (quantized family), peak implies ~4 GPUs to meet compute. For safety/resilience: reserve 4 GPUs and configure autoscale to 8 for bursts and AZ failover.
Sam (SRE): For latency SLO (99p <=300ms) we need tight batching and queueing controls. Recommend: max_batch_tokens 4096, max_batch_time_ms 20, queue_depth_guard 50ms. Enable KV/prefix caching for repeated users to cut compute.
Raj (SalesEng): Pricing suggestion: reserved pool (4 GPUs) monthly commit, with an autoscale burst addon that charges per-burst-hour to bring pool to 8. I9ll draft numbers.
Elaine (AM): Security checklist: customer requires KMS-managed keys, VPC peering, and audit logs with ~90+ day retention. Is Dedicated enough for pilot?
Maria (Infra): Yes: Dedicated pool + VPC peering + customer KMS is doable for pilot. Audit logs can be forwarded to their syslog/S3 and we can enable extended retention as an add-on. No full private install needed for the 4-week POC.
Sam (SRE): Operational fallback plan: if reserved pool exhausted route to a smaller quantized variant and enable a graceful degrade path (summary-only responses) to keep latency and error budget intact. Add circuit-breaker rules to avoid overload.
Raj (SalesEng): I9ll include the fallback language in the questionnaire reply and add a short appendix on expected quality delta. Elaine please DM the customer's security contact so I can loop Legal.
Elaine (AM): Sent contact via DM. ops-bot, can you create a prewarm runbook?
ops-bot: Runbook created: https://redwood.runbooks/runbook-3961 - steps: 1) provision reserved pool, 2) pre-create model shards, 3) seed KV cache, 4) smoke test (500 RPS, 10m), 5) ramp test to 4k spike window.
Maria (Infra): Scheduling a config review Thurs 10am PT. Sam you available?
Sam (SRE): Yep, added. Quick capacity snippet I used:
```
# capacity calc
RPS = 4000
tokens_per_request = 220
tokens_per_sec = RPS * tokens_per_request  # 880000
gpu_tokens_per_sec = 220000  # conservative per GPU (quantized)
required_gpus = ceil(tokens_per_sec / gpu_tokens_per_sec)  # ~4
# plan: reserve 4, autoscale to 8 for spikes, add AZ spread
```
Elaine (AM): Action items: Raj - pricing sketch EOD, Maria - provisioning + security appendix by EOD tomorrow, Sam - autoscale runbook + latency/SLO writeup before Thu review. Thanks all :thumbsup:
